units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:6">Kel. IX, 6</cite> (ed. Dehr. <cite ref="R00631"><he>צְנֵירָה</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="K00398"><he>כּוּשׁ</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:5">Ib. XIII, 5</cite> <he>צ׳ שפשטה</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>צני׳</he>) if a curved pin has been straightened.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:9">Ib. XI, 9</cite> <he>צ׳ טהורה</he> (Maim. ed. Dehr. <he>צני׳</he>) the hook of an earring (detached) is clean; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 9</cite> [read:] <he>צ׳ של נזם</he> (v. R. S. to Kel. l. c.). Ib. III, 7 <he>ניטל … מפני הצ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>הצינורות</he>) if the flat portion of the baker’s shovel is broken off, it is susceptible to uncleanness on account of the hook on the other end (used as a poker); <he>ניטלה הצ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>הצינורת</he>) if the curved end is broken off (v. <cite ref="S01327"><he>קַלִּיגְרָפוֹן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 12a:11">Yoma 12ᵃ</cite> <he>מהפך בצ׳</he> he turns (a piece of flesh &c. on the altar) with the hook.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:8">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:16">IX</cite>), 16 <he>כדי לעשות צ׳ קטנה</he> enough coal to forge a small hook; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:10">ib. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:5">X</cite>), 5 <he>כדי … ממנו צ׳ וכ׳</he> enough iron to make of it &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 107a">Men. 107ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 90a">Sabb. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ וכ׳</he> a small bronze hook.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:10">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>אפי׳ מחט אפי׳ צ׳ וכ׳</he> thou hast not found with me even a pin or a hook (of thine); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8:4">Num. R. s. 8</cite>, v. next w.]—Pl. <he>צִנּוֹרוֹת</he>, <he>צִנּוֹרִיּוֹת</he> (fr. <cite ref="R00618"><he>צִנּוֹרִית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 15</cite> <he>צ׳ התופסות וכ׳</he> the hooks which clasp the mill-stones from above.
<cite ref="Chagigah 21b">Ḥag. 21ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מחטין וצ׳</he> pins (or needles) and hooks; a. e.—Chald., v. <cite ref="R00615"><he>צִנּוֹרָא</he> I</cite>.
